scenes.audio: When the car moves forward, the tires are actually pushing backward against the ground.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A futuristic wedge-shaped electric sports car, primarily white with black lower trim, sits stationary on a dark asphalt surface at night. The camera is static at a low profile side-view. Harsh artificial lighting from the front-left creates sharp highlights on the car's angular body and deep shadows on the ground. The background is a pitch-black outdoor environment with distant, out-of-focus street or event lights.

scenes.audio: The tires push back, and the ground pushes the car forward. Just like when you run, the harder you push, the faster you sprint.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The camera pans slowly to the right, following the length of the car. The rear wheel is prominently displayed, featuring a solid disc-style aero cover. The lighting remains high-contrast, emphasizing the matte finish of the black trim. The car remains stationary during this camera movement.

scenes.audio: But if you push too hard, you will slip.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A tight shot on the rear wheel as it begins to spin rapidly. Smoke or tire vapor is visible at the contact patch where the rubber meets the dark pavement. The camera is low and static, focusing on the mechanical action of the tire interacting with the ground.

scenes.audio: The engineer on site gave a number.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A three-quarter rear view of the car on a brightly lit indoor stage. A man appears on the left side of the frame; he has short dark hair, light skin, and is wearing a dark t-shirt and dark trousers. He stands near the car with a relaxed posture. The stage background features a large dark structure and bright overhead studio lighting creating a clean, professional aesthetic.
